name: session-overview
description: Colored row above the terminal prompt: model, git branch, context %, session cost. Idle in the desktop app.

showEffort.title: Show effort
showEffort.description: Effort level beside the model, e.g. (high).

context.title: Context
context.description: both shows the bar and the percentage; bar or percent shows one; off hides the context.

tokens.title: Context tokens
tokens.description: Tokens and window beside the context, e.g. (64k/1M).

dropOrder.title: Hide order
dropOrder.description: When the row is wider than the terminal, parts are hidden one by one from left to right: the first listed goes first, until the row fits. Model and percent are never hidden; a branch still too long is shortened with an ellipsis. none hides nothing.
